notes.title: Don't worry, we are alive and kicking! Pricing Updates and more
Bug Fix - Now Go Save the Damsels!
notes.content:
A bug has been fixed the prevented users from saving the Damsels from the Dinos in certain scenarios. If you had issues with this encounter, please try again.

Now you can defeat the Dinos and save the Damsels, unlock those achievements and naughty artwork!

Thank you for playing, and I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: CyberSex 2069 releasing June 14th!
notes.content:
CyberSex 2069 has hit gold status and will be launching on steam on June 14th!

With over 200 naughty images it's sure to make your summer hotter than ever! And if you happen to be on the flip side of the planet, it will add some warmth you might be lacking. Either way, you don't want to miss out on the fun.
